title: Man Drops Killing Confession Randomly to Shocked Cops
description:
Bodycam footage shows 30-year-old Mamadi Tambajang walking into Sandy Springs Police HQ claiming he hurt his girlfriend "a day or two ago." Officers rush to the apartment and find 31-year-old Amber Kelly dead with severe head trauma.
